raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The image displays a pie chart illustrating the distribution of four categories related to the preparedness and qualification of professionals for projects adhering to the Passive House standard. The chart is divided into four segments: a large green segment representing 51%, a purple segment representing 23%, a red segment representing 23%, and a small blue segment representing 3%. Each segment is labeled with its corresponding percentage value in a black box with white text. The chart includes a legend on the right side that correlates each color with its respective category description in Bulgarian. The green segment corresponds to "Само малка част от изпълнителите/проектантите са подготвени да изпълняват проекти според стандарта Пасивна сграда, а голям брой специалисти имат нужда от обучения за изпълнението на стандарта" (Only a small portion of contractors/designers are prepared to execute projects according to the Passive House standard, and a large number of specialists require training to achieve the standard). The purple segment corresponds to "Няма достатъчно подготвени и квалифицирани специалисти за изграждане на сграда според стандарта Пасивна къща" (There are not enough prepared and qualified specialists to construct a building according to the Passive House standard). The red segment corresponds to "Само част от изпълнителите/проектантите са подготвени да изпълняват проекти според стандарта Пасивна сграда" (Only a portion of contractors/designers are prepared to execute projects according to the Passive House standard). The blue segment corresponds to "Подготвени и добре квалифицирани са, за да изпълняват проекти според стандарта Пасивна сграда" (Prepared and well-qualified to execute projects according to the Passive House standard). The segments are arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top right, with the largest segment (green) occupying the bottom half of the chart. There are no percentage labels inside the segments except for the black boxes indicating the percentages. The legend is positioned to the right of the chart and provides the textual descriptions for each color-coded segment.
